evidence_status: Anatomical topology supported; schematic-registered geometry and all peripheral parameters are uncalibrated estimates.

geometry_provenance.registration: Similarity transform: schematic pivot->haustellum landmark to rigging offset (-0.371, -0.0196) mm in x/z. Scale comes from existing rig, not figure scale bar. Unverified landmark correspondence.
geometry_provenance.uncertainty: Explore +/-20% attachment offsets; lateral depth is assumed; no measured 3D coordinate claim.

force_provenance: Assumed PCSA 0.001 mm^2 x 28 mN/mm^2 estimated specific tension. Specific tension is FlyMimic cross-muscle estimate, not M9 measurement (https://arxiv.org/html/2509.06426v2).
limitations: One right motor unit only; no mirrored motor signal or active antagonists.
Native generic force curves and activation are not calibrated adult M9 physiology.
Constant-length tendon, no pennation or series elasticity.
Passive joint spring/damping are estimates, not active retraction.
Tethered body and fixed other appendages; no walking controller.
Taste contact returns through mapped GRNs; muscle-specific proprioception remains unmapped.
